## 1. Executive Summary: Google AI Subscriptions × Antigravity × Vibe Coding
**Google Antigravity** (searched in Chinese as `Antigravity代儲`, `Antigravity 訂閱`, `Google Antigravity 訂閱`, `Antigravity代儲值`, `Antigravity代充`, `Antigravity代購`, `反重力 AI 代充`) is Google's Agent-First AI IDE powered by frontier Gemini & Claude models, parallel Mission Control subagents, and a built-in Browser Subagent for automated visual UI QA.

Crucially, **Antigravity has no standalone IDE subscription checkout** — its rate limits and frontier model pools scale directly with your personal **Google One / Google AI subscription tier** (`Free`, `Google AI Plus`, `Google AI Pro`, `Google AI Ultra 5x`, `Google AI Ultra 20x`).

For **Vibe Coders (`氛圍編程`)**, PMs, designers, solo founders, and software engineers, upgrading to **Google AI Ultra** solves three major bottlenecks:
1. **Eliminates Overage & Credit-Pack Anxiety**: Cloud builders like Lovable/Bolt deduct credits on every bug-fix prompt, while Cursor usage-based agent billing routinely spikes to $80–$160+/mo. Google AI Ultra caps monthly cost with predictable **5-hour rolling quota resets**.
2. **Cuts Retail Subscription Cost by ~60%**: Direct retail pricing for **Google AI Ultra 5x** is ~$99.99 USD/mo (NT$3,300/mo in Taiwan) and **Google AI Ultra 20x** is ~$199.99 USD/mo (NT$6,500/mo). **QuotaPulse** activates private seats directly on your own Google account at **$40 USD/mo (5x)** and **$80 USD/mo (20x)**.
3. **Consolidates 4 Solo-Founder AI Subscriptions into 1**: One personal Google AI Ultra account unlocks **Antigravity IDE (5x/20x)** + **Gemini Deep Think** + **Google Flow & Full Veo Video Generation** + **Top-Tier NotebookLM (up to 5,000 queries/day)** — requiring **zero Google passwords, zero 2FA codes, and zero gift-card region-lock risk**, backed by a **30-day pro-rata unused-day refund warranty** for non-personal issues.

## 4. Account Fulfillment Safety: Why Shared/Pooled & Gift Cards Fail
- **Shared / Pooled Accounts (`合租 / 拼車共享號`)**: Zero code privacy, 5-hour quota bucket drained in minutes by 5–10 co-renters, and high ban rates from simultaneous multi-country logins.
- **Cross-Region Google Play Gift Cards (`跨區點數卡 / 禮物卡`)**: High probability of permanent balance freezes (`"We need more info to redeem your gift card"`) requiring physical local store receipts.
- **QuotaPulse Personal Account Top-Up (`個人帳號免密碼直充`)**: 100% private seat on your own Google account, zero password/2FA/cookie ever requested, 10–30 min delivery (10:00–24:00 GMT+8), and pro-rata unused-day refund protection on non-personal interruptions.

---

## 5. Spec-Driven Vibe Coding & `.antigravityignore` Best Practices
1. **Spec First**: Draft `SPEC.md` in Gemini Deep Think + NotebookLM before spawning coding agents (cuts ~45% wasted rewrite loops).
2. **Add `.antigravityignore`** at repository root (`node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `.next/`, `.astro/`, `*.lock`, `public/*.png`, `public/*.mp4`) to save 30%–50% context tokens.
3. **Mode Discipline**: Use **Planning Mode** for multi-file architecture + Browser QA; switch to **Fast Mode** for CSS, copy, and small tweaks.
4. **Atomic Git Commits**: Commit working milestones frequently so bad iterations roll back in one second without burning quota.
